d: Chris and Casey Keefer tackle an Alaskan river untouched by hunters for a decade due to predation. The journey begins slowly, with more dragging than floating in a grizzly-heavy area.
The search for a mature moose begins as brothers Chris and Casey Keefer move their way downriver, but when they cross paths with a giant sow grizzly, they get way more than they bargained for.
As Chris and Casey Keefer continue downriver, they rely more on fish, ducks, and berries as the moose rut approaches. An epic Alaskan rainstorm brings heavy repercussions for their success.
Chris and Casey Keefer fish for dinner and edge closer to extraction. However, another encounter with a grizzly jeopardizes their safety as the bear ventures too close to camp!
As waterfowl migrate south, Chris and Casey Keefer shift focus to fishing for sustenance. After breaking camp, they head downriver toward an area they believe holds several moose, their main target.
Closing in on a moose-rich area, the brothers encounter a massive log jam, forcing them to navigate carefully. This obstacle risks diverting their route and jeopardizing the hunt.
After over three weeks, Chris and Casey Keefer reach the heart of moose country. Minutes after pitching their tent in a new spot, they come face-to-face with a giant bull.
As the 80-mile river journey nears its end, Chris and Casey Keefer have one last shot at an Alaskan moose before their extraction point.
In search of the biggest predatorial freshwater fish, Mario ventures deep into the darkest corners of the Amazon jungle where a tribal ceremony leaves him poisoned by a deadly frog.
Mario heads to the Flatlands of Columbia where he teams up with mystical cowboys of the land and goes in search of electric eel.
Mario ventures high into the Pyrenees mountain range in search of the elusive chamois, and decides to meet up with an old friend who is one of France's best wine makers.

In Cordoba, Argentina doves and pigeons are considered to be in plague proportions and culling them is necessary to maintain balance in the region... however, things turn a little competitive when Mario brings his dad to help.

Mario finds the help of a local Spanish baker to lead him high into the Becite mountain after Iberian Ibex, but he must first forage for truffles in order to make a European style pasta with the offal of this cagey mountain goat.

Mario ventures into the Atacama desert of Chile, where the volatile land filled with volcanic mountains and unforgiving terrain becomes a brutal mission that leaves him repelling down massive waterfalls to discover active puma dens.
Mario sets out into the La Pampa region of Argentina to share the bounty of his hard work harvesting wild food over a classic Asado with a beautiful local family.
